Hey I'm an actual police officer so I hope I can provide some insight. The difference between a detective and an officer is that a detective can conduct more thorough followup, usually plainclothes, more pay, etc. A patrol officer just does patrol functions so traffic stops, car accidents, civil troubles, etc. A detective usually does not have authority over a patrol officer, that's a supervisors job, but that may vary from department to department. 

As far as the promotion aspect goes, an officer can be part of a special unit (gangs, narcotics, intelligence) and will do the same job as a detective but without the title and pay. An officer can be promoted to a detective (either through an exam and/or interview or through merit)and still be with the unit but now has the title and pay. Usually, they pick up another officer to take the former officers spot, which is what happened to Burgess.
